sources.reviewed: Overview and all 19 listed candidate operations.
sources.findings: Ten selected tasks include Ethernet plug/coupler connection, a cable clip, protective cover and equipment controls. The nine excluded candidates include latched network disconnection, nut fastening, polarity-sensitive battery insertion and fault repair. Complete maintenance workflows are outside the reported benchmark scope.
sources.implication: Simple connector, battery and nut operations cannot claim novelty from object relabeling. A substantive workflow dependency might distinguish a task but still needs current board clearance.

sources.reviewed: Real-task catalog, simulation navigation catalog and Fasten Screws task details.
sources.findings: Fasten Screws uses three matching screw/nut pairs and checks alignment, rotational depth and gripper release, with partial credit by completed pairs.
sources.implication: Eight threaded nuts adds count to an established mechanism. Repetition alone remains inadequate; consider replacement or a distinct mechanically necessary assembly dependency.

sources.reviewed: All five suite name lists in the primary task map; blob 08144b4dd01d91fb0ca40e2c1d93ccaa85025fbc.
sources.findings: Placement, drawers, cabinet/microwave closure and stove actions overlap at the primitive level. No hardware-service mechanism was identified in this catalog.
sources.implication: Do not claim novelty from sequencing access and placement; distinguish physical retention dependencies.

sources.reviewed: Current primary registered-task imports, blob 2bdf3224717694d19143ad500e06202f7d2fcff8, plus atomic/composite documentation.
sources.findings: Lids, doors, racks and multi-step kitchen activities are already represented.
sources.implication: Sustained mechanical support and load capture distinguish these fixtures; long horizon alone does not.

sources.reviewed: Primary README current-environment table and named variants; blob c50eefbe64cc50ad218808a7a8c16d32d4353e6a.
sources.findings: Ten named task families cover picking, proximity, drawers, placement and stacking.
sources.implication: The maintenance mechanisms differ from listed tasks; this is a catalog comparison, not an exhaustive research claim.

sources.reviewed: 1016-entry index, searches for battery/repair/screw and full definitions of assembling_furniture, attach_a_camera_to_a_tripod and set_up_a_webcam.
sources.findings: Relevant assembly definitions use attachment goals. No matching battery-service or thread/preload dependency was identified in the checked definitions.
sources.implication: Search absence is not proof of no overlap. Compare each actual mechanism and its retention requirements.

fault-module-repair.distinctive_mechanism: Retain translated mass with free pin, leave pivot unpowered and free at intermediate equilibrium. Full physics/expert/Dream evidence completed. PR1647 open, intake team match rejected.

hinged-chassis-drive.distinctive_mechanism: Gravity-closing access lid plus capped horizontal carrier rails and separate bar retained by final lid closure. No RAID or live-server claim.

remote-battery-service.distinctive_mechanism: Maintain spring-return access support through removal and opposed-polarity exchange, compress terminal contact and close cover. Existing battery-service overlap remains material.

switch-map-rework.distinctive_mechanism: Correct existing latched mispatch, release spring catches with the other hand, park displaced tether temporarily, preserve third link. Native withdrawal remains unresolved.

node-service-closeout.distinctive_mechanism: Keyed cooler physically obstructs storage access, horizontal rails constrain storage, lid retains cooler. No paste-release or array-state claim.

twelve-cell-pack.distinctive_mechanism: Transfer shared terminal spring preload from hand-held pressure plate to separate collision-retained cross-key. Twelve preloaded cells declared. Repetition provides no novelty.

eight-nut-bracket.distinctive_mechanism: Native threads must advance axially and eventually capture spring-loaded plate after hand support. Eight copies provide no novelty. Physical expert threading remains unresolved.

hardware-order-kit.distinctive_mechanism: Gravity hinge, keyed torque registration and loaded cross-pin seam around captive shaft. Significant shared split-access geometry. Native fit and load retention must justify distinction.

board_refresh_2026_11_11.decision_scope: Internal mechanism comparison. Official novelty and acceptance decisions belong to reviewers. Pending submissions can change.

board_delta_1555.decision: No newly listed mechanism materially duplicates the eight current candidates. Existing close-neighbor concerns remain task-specific and require their declared distinct mechanisms to work.

closest_new_neighbor.title: Push-fit an elbow onto a copper and a plastic pipe, with an insert in the plastic one
closest_new_neighbor.comparison: Sequential axial pipe fitting and conditional insert placement. Hardware candidate opens a hinged split collar around a shaft with captive ends, then installs a transverse seam-locking key. Nut candidate advances helical contacts to retain a sprung plate. These dependent physical operations differ from elbow push-fit and pipe stiffening.
